newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy details results of latest Eni sale.
newsitem.headline: Italy details results of latest Eni sale.

text.p: Some 340,338 retail subscribers bought 657.486 million shares in the second tranche of the privatisation of Italian state-controlled energy group ENI, according to an ENI tombstone in Italian dailies.
ENI employees, buying 84.169 million shares on offer, totalled 42,149 while requests in Italy for 257.400 million shares came from 158 institutional investors, it said.

The Italian Treasury sold about 14 percent of ENI in the offer and Treasury Minister Carlo Azeglio Ciampi said at least 7.7 trillion lire ($5 billion) was raised from the sale of a total 1.1 billion ENI shares which closed on Friday.
ENI, also listed in New York and London, is the largest publicly traded company in Italy and the sixth largest publicly traded oil and gas company in the world.
The Treasury still holds around 70 percent of the company.
